content.about: Niger is a large, landlocked country in West Africa, mostly Sahara. The Niger River flows through its southwest. The Aïr Mountains hold rock art. Its Wodaabe people hold the Gerewol festival.

standout.text: Niger's Ténéré is one of the Sahara's largest sand seas.

didYouKnow: The Tree of Ténéré was once the most isolated tree on Earth.
Dinosaur fossils have been found in Niger.
Agadez has a famous mud-brick minaret.
